verses.original: וּבֹ֨עַז עָלָ֣ה הַשַּׁעַר֮ וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב שָׁם֒ וְהִנֵּ֨ה הַגֹּאֵ֤ל עֹבֵר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּר־ בֹּ֔עַז וַיֹּ֛אמֶר ס֥וּרָה שְׁבָה־ פֹּ֖ה פְּלֹנִ֣י אַלְמֹנִ֑י וַיָּ֖סַר וַיֵּשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇō·‘az ‘ā·lāh haš·ša·‘ar way·yê·šeḇ šām wə·hin·nêh hag·gō·’êl ‘ō·ḇêr ’ă·šer dib·ber- bō·‘az way·yō·mer sū·rāh šə·ḇāh- pōh pə·lō·nî ’al·mō·nî way·yā·sar way·yê·šêḇ
verses.literal: Meanwhile, Boaz went to the gate and sat down there Soon the kinsman-redeemer of whom he had spoken came along and Boaz said Come over here my friend . . . and sit down So he went over and sat down

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח עֲשָׂרָ֧ה אֲנָשִׁ֛ים מִזִּקְנֵ֥י הָעִ֖יר וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁבוּ־ פֹ֑ה וַיֵּשֵֽׁבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ‘ă·śā·rāh ’ă·nā·šîm miz·ziq·nê hā·‘îr way·yō·mer šə·ḇū- p̄ōh way·yê·šê·ḇū
verses.literal: Then Boaz took ten . . . of the elders of the city and said Sit here and they did so

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לַגֹּאֵ֔ל חֶלְקַת֙ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְאָחִ֖ינוּ לֶאֱלִימֶ֑לֶךְ מָכְרָ֣ה נָעֳמִ֔י הַשָּׁ֖בָה מִשְּׂדֵ֥ה מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lag·gō·’êl ḥel·qaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh ’ă·šer lə·’ā·ḥî·nū le·’ĕ·lî·me·leḵ mā·ḵə·rāh nā·‘o·mî haš·šā·ḇāh miś·śə·ḏêh mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: And he said to the kinsman-redeemer Naomi who has returned from the land of Moab is selling the piece of land that belonged to our brother Elimelech

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֨י אָמַ֜רְתִּי אֶגְלֶ֧ה אָזְנְךָ֣ לֵאמֹ֗ר קְ֠נֵה נֶ֥גֶד הַֽיֹּשְׁבִים֮ וְנֶ֣גֶד זִקְנֵ֣י עַמִּי֒ אִם־ תִּגְאַל֙ גְּאָ֔ל וְאִם־ לֹ֨א יִגְאַ֜ל הַגִּ֣ידָה לִּ֗י וְאֵדַע כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין זוּלָֽתְךָ֙ לִגְא֔וֹל וְאָנֹכִ֖י אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אָנֹכִ֥י אֶגְאָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ’ā·mar·tî ’eḡ·leh ’ā·zə·nə·ḵā lê·mōr qə·nêh ne·ḡeḏ hay·yō·šə·ḇîm wə·ne·ḡeḏ ziq·nê ‘am·mî ’im- tiḡ·’al gə·’āl wə·’im- lō yiḡ·’al hag·gî·ḏāh lî wə·ʾē·ḏaʿ kî ’ên zū·lā·ṯə·ḵā liḡ·’ō·wl wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā way·yō·mer ’ā·nō·ḵî ’eḡ·’āl
verses.literal: I thought I should inform you that you may buy it back in the presence of those seated here and in the presence of the elders of my people If you want to redeem it do so But if you will not redeem it tell me so I may know because there is no one but you to redeem it and I am next after you I will redeem it he replied

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר בֹּ֔עַז בְּיוֹם־ קְנוֹתְךָ֥ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה מִיַּ֣ד נָעֳמִ֑י וּ֠מֵאֵת ר֣וּת הַמּוֹאֲבִיָּ֤ה אֵֽשֶׁת־ הַמֵּת֙ קָנִיתִי לְהָקִ֥ים שֵׁם־ הַמֵּ֖ת עַל־ נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bō·‘az bə·yō·wm- qə·nō·wṯ·ḵā haś·śā·ḏeh mî·yaḏ nā·‘o·mî ū·mê·’êṯ rūṯ ham·mō·w·’ă·ḇî·yāh ’ê·šeṯ- ham·mêṯ qå̄·nī·ṯī lə·hā·qîm šêm- ham·mêṯ ‘al- na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Then Boaz said On the day you buy the land from Naomi and also from Ruth the Moabitess you must also acquire the widow of the deceased in order to raise up the name of the deceased on his inheritance

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַגֹּאֵ֗ל לֹ֤א אוּכַל֙ לִגְאוֹל לִ֔י פֶּן־ אַשְׁחִ֖ית אֶת־ נַחֲלָתִ֑י גְּאַל־ לְךָ֤ אַתָּה֙ אֶת־ גְּאֻלָּתִ֔י כִּ֥י לֹא־ אוּכַ֖ל לִגְאֹֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hag·gō·’êl lō ’ū·ḵal liḡ·ʾōl pen- ’aš·ḥîṯ ’eṯ- na·ḥă·lā·ṯî gə·’al- lə·ḵā ’at·tāh ’eṯ- gə·’ul·lā·ṯî kî lō- ’ū·ḵal liḡ·’ōl
verses.literal: The kinsman-redeemer replied I cannot . . . redeem it myself or I would jeopardize my own inheritance Take my right of redemption . . . . . . . . . because I cannot . . . redeem it

verses.original: וְזֹאת֩ לְפָנִ֨ים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל עַל־ הַגְּאוּלָּ֤ה וְעַל־ הַתְּמוּרָה֙ לְקַיֵּ֣ם כָּל־ דָּבָ֔ר שָׁלַ֥ף אִ֛ישׁ נַעֲל֖וֹ וְנָתַ֣ן לְרֵעֵ֑הוּ וְזֹ֥את הַתְּעוּדָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zōṯ lə·p̄ā·nîm bə·yiś·rā·’êl ‘al- hag·gə·’ūl·lāh wə·‘al- hat·tə·mū·rāh lə·qay·yêm kāl- dā·ḇār šā·lap̄ ’îš na·‘ă·lōw wə·nā·ṯan lə·rê·‘ê·hū wə·zōṯ hat·tə·‘ū·ḏāh bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now in former times in Israel concerning the redemption . . . or exchange of property to make any matter legally binding a man would remove his sandal and give it to the other party and this was a confirmation in Israel

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר הַגֹּאֵ֛ל לְבֹ֖עַז קְנֵה־ לָ֑ךְ וַיִּשְׁלֹ֖ף נַעֲלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hag·gō·’êl lə·ḇō·‘az qə·nêh- lāḵ way·yiš·lōp̄ na·‘ă·lōw
verses.literal: So the kinsman-redeemer removed his sandal and said to Boaz Buy it for yourself

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ בֹּ֨עַז לַזְּקֵנִ֜ים וְכָל־ הָעָ֗ם עֵדִ֤ים אַתֶּם֙ הַיּ֔וֹם כִּ֤י קָנִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֶֽאֱלִימֶ֔לֶךְ וְאֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְכִלְי֖וֹן וּמַחְל֑וֹן מִיַּ֖ד נָעֳמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bō·‘az laz·zə·qê·nîm wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām ‘ê·ḏîm ’at·tem hay·yō·wm kî qā·nî·ṯî ’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer le·’ĕ·lî·me·leḵ wə·’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer lə·ḵil·yō·wn ū·maḥ·lō·wn mî·yaḏ nā·‘o·mî
verses.literal: At this, Boaz said to the elders and all the people You are witnesses today that I am buying from Naomi all that belonged to Elimelech - Chilion and Mahlon

verses.original: וְגַ֣ם אֶת־ ר֣וּת הַמֹּאֲבִיָּה֩ אֵ֨שֶׁת מַחְל֜וֹן קָנִ֧יתִי לִ֣י לְאִשָּׁ֗ה לְהָקִ֤ים שֵׁם־ הַמֵּת֙ עַל־ נַ֣חֲלָת֔וֹ וְלֹא־ יִכָּרֵ֧ת שֵׁם־ הַמֵּ֛ת מֵעִ֥ם אֶחָ֖יו וּמִשַּׁ֣עַר מְקוֹמ֑וֹ עֵדִ֥ים אַתֶּ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ’eṯ- rūṯ ham·mō·’ă·ḇî·yāh ’ê·šeṯ maḥ·lō·wn qā·nî·ṯî lî lə·’iš·šāh lə·hā·qîm šêm- ham·mêṯ ‘al- na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw wə·lō- yik·kā·rêṯ šêm- ham·mêṯ mê·‘im ’e·ḥāw ū·miš·ša·‘ar mə·qō·w·mōw ‘ê·ḏîm ’at·tem hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Moreover I have acquired . . . Ruth the Moabitess Mahlon’s widow as my wife to raise up the name of the deceased through his inheritance so that his name will not disappear from among his brothers or from the gate of his home You are witnesses today . . .

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ כָּל־ הָעָ֧ם אֲשֶׁר־ בַּשַּׁ֛עַר וְהַזְּקֵנִ֖ים עֵדִ֑ים יִתֵּן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶֽת־ הָאִשָּׁ֜ה הַבָּאָ֣ה אֶל־ בֵּיתֶ֗ךָ כְּרָחֵ֤ל׀ וּכְלֵאָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנ֤וּ שְׁתֵּיהֶם֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַעֲשֵׂה־ חַ֣יִל בְּאֶפְרָ֔תָה וּקְרָא־ שֵׁ֖ם בְּבֵ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū kāl- hā·‘ām ’ă·šer- baš·ša·‘ar wə·haz·zə·qê·nîm ‘ê·ḏîm yit·tên Yah·weh ’eṯ- hā·’iš·šāh hab·bā·’āh ’el- bê·ṯe·ḵā kə·rā·ḥêl ū·ḵə·lê·’āh ’ă·šer bā·nū šə·tê·hem ’eṯ- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl wa·‘ă·śêh- ḥa·yil bə·’ep̄·rā·ṯāh ū·qə·rā- šêm bə·ḇêṯ lā·ḥem
verses.literal: We are witnesses said the elders and all the people at the gate May the LORD make the woman entering . . . your home like Rachel and Leah who together built up . . . the house of Israel May you be prosperous in Ephrathah and famous . . . in Bethlehem

verses.original: וִיהִ֤י בֵֽיתְךָ֙ כְּבֵ֣ית פֶּ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יָלְדָ֥ה תָמָ֖ר לִֽיהוּדָ֑ה מִן־ הַזֶּ֗רַע אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ לְךָ֔ מִן־ הַֽנַּעֲרָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hî ḇê·ṯə·ḵā kə·ḇêṯ pe·reṣ ’ă·šer- yā·lə·ḏāh ṯā·mār lî·hū·ḏāh min- haz·ze·ra‘ ’ă·šer yit·tên Yah·weh lə·ḵā min- han·na·‘ă·rāh haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: And may your house become like the house of Perez whom Tamar bore to Judah because of the offspring the LORD will give you by this young woman

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח בֹּ֤עַז אֶת־ רוּת֙ וַתְּהִי־ ל֣וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֖א אֵלֶ֑יהָ וַיִּתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֥ה לָ֛הּ הֵרָי֖וֹן וַתֵּ֥לֶד בֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ bō·‘az ’eṯ- rūṯ wat·tə·hî- lōw lə·’iš·šāh way·yā·ḇō ’ê·le·hā way·yit·tên Yah·weh lāh hê·rā·yō·wn wat·tê·leḏ bên
verses.literal: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife And when he had relations with her the LORD enabled her to conceive and she gave birth to a son

verses.original: וַתֹּאמַ֤רְנָה הַנָּשִׁים֙ אֶֽל־ נָעֳמִ֔י בָּר֣וּךְ יְהוָ֔ה אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹ֣א הִשְׁבִּ֥ית לָ֛ךְ גֹּאֵ֖ל הַיּ֑וֹם וְיִקָּרֵ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mar·nāh han·nā·šîm ’el- nā·‘o·mî bā·rūḵ Yah·weh ’ă·šer lō hiš·bîṯ lāḵ gō·’êl hay·yō·wm wə·yiq·qā·rê šə·mōw bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then the women said to Naomi Blessed be the LORD who has not left you this day without a kinsman-redeemer May his name become famous in Israel

verses.original: וְהָ֤יָה לָךְ֙ לְמֵשִׁ֣יב נֶ֔פֶשׁ וּלְכַלְכֵּ֖ל אֶת־ שֵׂיבָתֵ֑ךְ כִּ֣י כַלָּתֵ֤ךְ אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ אֲהֵבַ֙תֶךְ֙ יְלָדַ֔תּוּ אֲשֶׁר־ הִיא֙ ט֣וֹבָה לָ֔ךְ מִשִּׁבְעָ֖ה בָּנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh lāḵ lə·mê·šîḇ ne·p̄eš ū·lə·ḵal·kêl ’eṯ- śê·ḇā·ṯêḵ kî ḵal·lā·ṯêḵ ’ăšer- ’ă·hê·ḇa·ṯeḵ yə·lā·ḏat·tū ’ă·šer- hî ṭō·w·ḇāh lāḵ miš·šiḇ·‘āh bā·nîm
verses.literal: He will renew . . . your life and sustain you in your old age For your daughter-in-law who loves you and is better to you than seven sons has given him birth

verses.original: וַתִּקַּ֨ח נָעֳמִ֤י אֶת־ הַיֶּ֙לֶד֙ וַתְּשִׁתֵ֣הוּ בְחֵיקָ֔הּ וַתְּהִי־ ל֖וֹ לְאֹמֶֽנֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·qaḥ nā·‘o·mî ’eṯ- hay·ye·leḏ wat·tə·ši·ṯê·hū ḇə·ḥê·qāh wat·tə·hî- lōw lə·’ō·me·neṯ
verses.literal: And Naomi took the child placed him on her lap and became a nurse to him

verses.original: וַתִּקְרֶאנָה֩ ל֨וֹ הַשְּׁכֵנ֥וֹת שֵׁם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יֻלַּד־ בֵּ֖ן לְנָעֳמִ֑י וַתִּקְרֶ֤אנָֽה שְׁמוֹ֙ עוֹבֵ֔ד ה֥וּא אֲבִי־ יִשַׁ֖י אֲבִ֥י דָוִֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·re·nāh lōw haš·šə·ḵê·nō·wṯ šêm lê·mōr yul·laḏ- bên lə·nā·‘o·mî wat·tiq·re·nāh šə·mōw ‘ō·w·ḇêḏ hū ’ă·ḇî- yi·šay ’ă·ḇî ḏā·wiḏ
verses.literal: The neighbor women said A son has been born to Naomi . . . . . . and they named him Obed He became the father of Jesse the father of David

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ תּוֹלְד֣וֹת פָּ֔רֶץ פֶּ֖רֶץ הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ חֶצְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh tō·wl·ḏō·wṯ pā·reṣ pe·reṣ hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- ḥeṣ·rō·wn
verses.literal: Now these are the generations of Perez Perez was the father of Hezron

verses.original: וְחֶצְרוֹן֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ רָ֔ם וְרָ֖ם הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ עַמִּֽינָדָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥeṣ·rō·wn hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- rām wə·rām hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- ‘am·mî·nā·ḏāḇ
verses.literal: Hezron was the father of Ram Ram was the father of Amminadab

verses.original: וְעַמִּֽינָדָב֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ נַחְשׁ֔וֹן וְנַחְשׁ֖וֹן הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ שַׂלְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘am·mî·nā·ḏāḇ hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- naḥ·šō·wn wə·naḥ·šō·wn hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- śal·māh
verses.literal: Amminadab was the father of Nahshon Nahshon was the father of Salmon

verses.original: וְשַׂלְמוֹן֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ בֹּ֔עַז וּבֹ֖עַז הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ עוֹבֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śal·mō·wn hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- bō·‘az ū·ḇō·‘az hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- ‘ō·w·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: Salmon was the father of Boaz Boaz was the father of Obed

verses.original: וְעֹבֵד֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ יִשָׁ֔י וְיִשַׁ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ דָּוִֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ō·ḇêḏ hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- yi·šāy wə·yi·šay hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ
verses.literal: Obed was the father of Jesse and Jesse was the father of David
